rationale.conceptual: The method uses an established but non-trivial combination of DFT, COHP analysis, and rigid-band filling with DOS integration. It requires careful implementation of the COHP-to-optimum-band-filling logic, and domain knowledge in electronic structure and bonding analysis, but no novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves setting up and running DFT for seven distinct materials, post-processing with LOBSTER, parsing COHP/DOS outputs, and integrating to derive VEC_st. This is a multi-tool orchestration with fragile handoffs (geometry inputs, pseudopotential selection, LOBSTER input preparation) and more than 4 stages.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires running DFT+COHP calculations for seven half-Heusler phases, which is a non-trivial but standard computational materials science workflow. The method follows a published rigid-band analysis approach, involving multiple interacting components (DFT scf, COHP post-processing, DOS integration). The execution pipeline is multi-stage and fragile due to tool orchestration. Resource needs are modest (small cells, CPU-only DFT).
